name: toon
description: Deterministic hook pair that routes JSON-emitting Bash commands through the TOON encoder (~40-60% fewer tokens). PreToolUse appends a safe toon-pipe wrapper as the final stage of high-confidence commands; PostToolUse parses actual output as ground truth, replaces it with TOON, and teaches a shared registry so detection improves over time.

interface.shortDescription: Auto-route JSON-emitting Bash commands through the TOON encoder (~40-60% fewer tokens).
capabilities: Rewrites high-confidence JSON commands to pipe through toon at the source
Converts confirmed JSON tool output to TOON after the fact
Learns JSON-emitting command signatures in a shared registry
